Khamoshi zindagi hai.
Sunshine ki taraf face rakho, shadow nazar nahi aata.
Ek shant man ek sahasi vichar ka upjaau zameen hai.
Grit lamba hai.
Sahas sabhi gunon mein sabse zaroori hai, kyunki sahas ke bina koi bhi gun lagatar nahi chal sakta.
Khamoshi ko surrender se na jodo.
Darr ka na hona himmat nahi hai.
Himmat pehla insani gun hai—kyunki ye baaki sabki guarantee karta hai.
Khamoshi se duniya jeeto.
Asli taqat shant dil mein basti hai.
Jo lagta hai na ho sake, wahi karo.
Bada hona aur asli banta—courage lagta.
Apne jazbe ko dar ke aage kabhi shaant mat hone do.
Grit—jab mushkil ho tab bhi work ke saath stick rehna.
Grit mehnat aur ghisai hai.
Courage woh nahi ke tumhare paas strength ho—courage to tab hai jab strength na ho phir bhi chalte raho.
Grit—jab quit karna easy ho tab bhi refuse karna.
